name: InterContinental Miami
insider_take: This downtown Miami icon stands as the tallest hotel building in the city, offering unparalleled views of Biscayne Bay and the glittering Miami skyline from its prime waterfront location.
whats_special: The hotel's unique spiral design creates stunning curved balconies on every floor, while its ground-level location puts you steps from the Miami River and within walking distance of the historic Flagler Street shopping district. The property features the city's only hotel with direct access to the Metromover, Miami's free downtown transit system.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view room on floors 20+ for breathtaking sunrise views over the Atlantic, and time your arrival with the daily 6 PM drawbridge opening on the nearby Brickell Avenue Bridge - a quintessential Miami moment.
dont_miss: The rooftop pool deck offers 360-degree city views, while the hotel's proximity to Bayfront Park means you're just a 3-minute walk from free outdoor concerts and the famous Laser Light Symphony shows that illuminate Biscayne Bay on weekend evenings.
pros: Prime downtown Miami location with easy access to business district and attractions
Luxury amenities including rooftop pool and spa facilities
Stunning views of Biscayne Bay and Miami skyline
Multiple dining options including signature restaurants
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury downtown hotels
Urban setting with busy city environment
